spans.s: चिन्तक a. mindful of, intent upon (—˚).

चिन्तनीय a. to be thought of, attended to, or found
out.

चिन्ता f. thought, consideration, reflection, care or sorrow
about (gen., loc., or उपरि).
चिन्तामोह m. confusion of the mind.
1 चिन्त्य a. = चिन्तनीय, also uncertain, questionable.
चिन्मय a. consisting of intelligence, spiritual.

चिन्मात्र a. consisting only of intelligence, quite
spiritual.
